contract.comparison_limit: Native full search closure shares its one compute CPU; V45 moves support stages onto the two support CPUs. Official native compiler flags are not matched to V45.

hardware.scope: Guest-reported hardware; three Docker nodes share one KVM VM. Physical host isolation/cache topology not established.
hardware.storage_backend_user_reported: Proxmox/Ceph; 2 Gbps storage network reported by operator, not independently measured in this campaign

runtime_cpu_observation.proc_cpu_ticks_scope: Same TID starttime and unchanged comm across observations after start(); first-seen lifetime ticks excluded.
runtime_cpu_observation.schedstat_scope: Newborn active-thread schedstat lifetime runtime is diagnostic proof only and is never added to interval CPU ticks or used as utilization.
runtime_cpu_observation.affinity_scope: Each sampled Cpus_allowed_list is checked; unsampled transients and maximum wrong-mask duration are not inferred.
runtime_cpu_observation.rename_policy: For comm changes during the mask read, the mask must satisfy at least one adjacent source phase; transition samples are recorded.

files.claim: veortex-flat-c{core_id} pins to core_id before readiness and re-pins before each job
ring startup has an explicit transition name; activation pins to the selected compute core before setting the active ring name

route_metric_delta.scope: Process-global Prometheus counters bracket one timed row on each node
